title: Smoother updates and file operations
notes: New: Installed Windows copies can now check for updates automatically on a schedule. You can cancel the countdown before an update is installed.
New: Use Find locking processes from the command palette to see which apps are using selected files or folders.
Improved: Delete and locking-process searches can run in minimizable, cancellable progress dialogs, and their minimize buttons are keyboard-accessible.
Fixed: FTP bookmark host names are now preserved when copying, pasting, or dragging files.
